Name: Transtar
Author: wanniwa
Description:
[size=3]A translation tool.

星露谷物语-Transtar-翻译工具教学：[/size][url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1n1421b7bx][size=3]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1n1421b7bx[/size]
[/url][size=3]不要纯机翻完就发布！！！！！
不要用此工具剽窃别人的翻译！
所有的翻译都尽量原作者联系拿到授权再做翻译，做到尊重，也方便﻿让其他人知道有人正在翻译。[/size]

[size=5]
[url=https://github.com/wanniwa/transtar]https://github.com/wanniwa/transtar[/url][/size]



[b][center][size=5]Feature[/size][/center][/b][list]
[*][size=3]Extract mod entry, therefore, you do not need to understand various framework formats.[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿﻿Extract sentence in CP﻿ file and not in i18n file（The mod author can use it to check if there are any missing sentences that have not been placed in the i18n file）[/size]
[*][size=3]The entire process from extraction to generating the final translation file.[/size]
[size=3][*]﻿Verify if there are any omissions or losses in the translated text, such as %farm, $1, ^, #.
[*]Support machine and AI translate

[/size][/list]
[b][size=5][center]Who needs to use it[/center][/size][/b][size=3][left][list]
[*]Mod translators or teams translating a large number of mods.
[/list][/left][/size][size=5][b][center]How to use[/center][/b][/size][size=3][b]Install[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Only support windows.[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿Download and unzip the file to a separate folder.[/size]﻿﻿
[*][size=3]Run transtar.exe and select your language.[/size]
[*]Drop the mod folder that you want to translate into the drop area or select the folder manually.
[/list][size=3][b]
Extract[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Click the extract button, and a 'dict' folder will be generated, containing the content that requires translation.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
﻿[/size][size=3][b]Extract old
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Do not plagiarize another author's translation by using the 'Extract old' without authorization from the original translator.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]If you already have a dict file, you don't need to use this feature, you just need to click extract when updating[/size]
[*][size=3]Click extract old button.[/size]
[*][size=3]Select the original mod folder of the old version and the folder of the old version of the mod with the translation already installed.[/size]
[*][size=3]Click ﻿Execute button.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][b][size=3]Translate[/size]
（[/b][size=2][b]遇到cannot unpack non-iterabled nonetype object这个报错是你网络访问不了Google翻译。要开梯子，[/b][b]没有梯子的话，你可以把dict文件直接上传协作平台，然后自己在浏览器上翻，或者直接打开dict文件夹里面的内容，把translation属性替换成中文。[/b][/size][b][size=3]）[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Click translate button.[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿When it has finished. choose a way to optimize translation[/size]
[size=3]First way: Open the "dict" folder, and open each JSON file in "dict" folder, replace the content in the "translation" field of each entry with the better translated sentences.
Second way:  upload the content from the "dict" files to [url=https://paratranz.cn/]https://paratranz.cn/[/url], which is a collaborative translation platform for managing changes to our entries and facilitating team-based translation.﻿[/size][/list][size=3] ﻿Tips:
﻿If one wants to use ParaTranz.First, you need to have a GitHub account to log in to the ParaTranz website, then you need to create a project of your own , and then you can upload the "dict" folder or files to this website to translate.

[size=3][b]Check[/b][list]
[*]check that your "dict" folder exists and that its contents have been translated
[*]click ﻿[b]Check[/b] button
[*]if success will notice
[*]if error will pop a folder named error,check files in it.
[*]fix the error in dict file until no error
[*]click import from error button
[/list][/size][/size][size=3]
[b]Generate[/b]
[list]
[*]check that your "dict" folder exists and that its contents have been translated
[*]If you used the second way to translate, you just need to download the files you uploaded and place them back into the "dict" folder.
[*]Drop your mod folder （not dict folder）to [b]drop area[/b]
[*]﻿click ﻿[b]Generate[/b] button
[*]After completing the generation, a mod translation package will be generated
[/list][/size]
[left][b][size=5]Support framework[/size][/b][/left][list]
[*][size=3][CP]:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]i18n[/size]
[*][size=3][JA]:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]﻿[MFM]:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url][/size]
[*][size=3][STF] Shop Tile Framework(mod deprecated)[/size]
[*][size=3][QF]:Quest Framework(mod deprecated)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
